question: Can the existing 2R-confirmation add-back be limited to fee-net TP profits remaining after reserving the original runner's fixed-stop loss?
single_variable: Change only the maximum quantity of each existing add-back. The signal, H1 entry, protected shadow exit, original 2/3 TP and 1/3 runner, admission, and slot timing remain fixed.

baseline.portfolio: 2/3 closes at maker 2R; 1/3 follows the original cloud runner
baseline.selection: Reuse the frozen funded actual paths, same-time prior-ATR ranking, and original capacity admission

add_back.frequency: At most one add-back for each actually funded original parent, using the same 381 causally validated candidates and the existing 12H-confirmed H1 open.
add_back.eligibility: The actual original 2R partial must have closed in a strictly earlier H1 bar and its original 1/3 runner must still be open at the add-back open.
add_back.entry_and_exit: Unchanged existing profit-confirm-entry path, same side, exact H1 opening quote, +0.5 original-R protection, and native shadow exit bounded by the original runner exit.
add_back.profit_budget_formula: At the callback, calculate actual fee-net PnL already realized by the original 2/3 TP leg. Subtract the still-open original runner's maximum fee-net loss from its actual entry fill to its original fixed stop execution. Clamp at zero. Do not credit unrealized runner gains.
add_back.addon_risk_formula: Calculate one-unit fee-net loss from the actual add-back entry fill to its then-known +0.5R protection, including entry and stop taker fees. Under 5bp stress also include adverse entry and stop slippage. Maximum quantity = positive profit budget / positive unit loss.
position_caps: The ordinary add-back notional remains capped by the actual original 2R leg entry notional.
The add-back remains capped by VectorBT free cash at its order callback.
No add-back is placed when the profit budget or valid stop loss distance is non-positive.
add_back.runner_reserve: Reserve the loss from the original runner's actual entry quantity, executed entry price, entry fee, original fixed stop price and taker stop fee. Use no current runner mark or floating profit.
add_back.parent_accounting: Use the same shared VectorBT cash account. Merge child add-back PnL into its original parent for account win/payoff metrics; separately retain add-back ledger and leg metrics.
add_back.original_positions: Original TP and runner fills, original slot occupancy, signal order, and all non-add-back decisions are unchanged.

evaluation.development_gate: At least 100 original parent trades; use the existing wallet.qualifies thresholds and require equal-notional net payoff >=2.5.
evaluation.conditional_checks: Only after development passes, run the pre-existing paired actual subset, matched controls and +5bp market-fill stress.
evaluation.zero_add_gate: Before the profit-budget policy, require the current zero-add adapter to reproduce all 1,569 frozen funded original cash PnLs/notionals and every hourly NAV/open/high-low field within 1e-6.
evaluation.risk_audit: Record realized TP net profit, reserved runner stop loss, available positive budget, one-unit add-back stop loss, quantity cap, actual quantity, stop risk used and unused budget. Assert actual add-back stop risk never exceeds available budget.

implementation.engine: Reuse cloud_close_reinvest_runner's VectorBT Portfolio.from_order_func cash-sharing adapter with the new profit-only callback hook enabled; default hook remains off for prior behavior.
